# trusted-local extension execution

_status: experimental · owner: core · id: `extensions.execution`_

## the one command

```
hosaka extensions run reference-extension echo --params '{"message":"Hello"}'
```

## why you care

One supervised runtime for CLI, TUI and Menu actions, with honest trust boundaries.

## what it does

Run explicitly digest-approved code in bounded workers with schema checks, narrow data/log context, safe mode and cancellation. NOT an OS sandbox; approved Python retains user privileges. Root/public execution is refused.

## commands

- `/extensions trust <id> --trusted-local --allow-storage`
- `/extensions revoke <id>`
- `/extensions run <id> <action> --params JSON`
- `/extensions cancel <id> <invocation-uuid>`
- `/extensions safe-mode on`
- `/extensions safe-mode off`

## entrypoints

- `POST /api/v1/extensions/{identifier}/actions/{action}`
- `POST /api/v1/extensions/{identifier}/cancel/{invocation_id}`

## what success looks like / what failure looks like

if it works, it's quiet. if it doesn't, expect one of:

- disabled, unapproved, changed, root/public or safe-mode packages cannot execute
- invalid input/output, timeout, output flood, nonzero exit and exceptions return explicit failures
- trusted code is not OS-contained and can bypass same-user advisory limits
